constraints: Python-first implementation is preferred but comparison evidence is required.
Hosted or self-hosted observability telemetry must be explicit and additive to deterministic validation.
Deterministic validation must run without hosted credentials.
Self-hosted Langfuse is preferred for product-grade agent traces when service-backed proof is needed.
Durable execution must be proven through local or self-hosted evidence, not assumed.
objective: Compare self-hostable agent application stacks through runnable candidate implementations.
